class.name: IfcTableColumn
class.brief_description: An IfcTableColumn is a data structure that captures column information for use in an IfcTable . Each instance defines the name, description, identifier, and units of measure that are applicable to the columnar data associated with the IfcTableRow objects. The use of IfcTableColumn supercedes the IsHeading flag associated with IfcTableRow . HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4.
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: Table column identifier. A String, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The table column display name. A String, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
Descriptive text for the table column. A String, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The unit of measure to be used for this column's data. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
